JACINTH MANUEL J
Software Development Engineer
9677950295 | jacinthmanuel2310@gmail.com | LinkedIn | GitHub | Tirunelveli |
SUMMARY
B.Tech student in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science with demonstrated experience in Machine learning,
data science, and Full-stack application development. Possesses a strong foundation in Computer
Networking and Operating Systems, Data Structures and Algorithms enabling effective system-level analysis
and the design of scalable, efficient solutions. Proven ability to rapidly acquire new skills, translate theoretical
concepts into practical implementations, and deliver high-impact projects.
PROJECTS
Transaction Management System Using Monitors
Implemented a banking system using C with pthread mutex locks to simulate Monitor-based
synchronization.
Prevented race conditions and ensured data consistency through mutual exclusion and thread-
safe critical section handling.
Tamil Handwritten Character Recognition using CNN
Implemented a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) using TensorFlow and Keras for multi-class
image classification.
Achieved high accuracy through data augmentation and optimized model architecture for
robust real-world performance.
LAN-Based File Transfer System
Implemented a LAN-based file transfer system using the Sliding Window Protocol.
Improved network throughput by allowing the sender to transmit multiple data frames without
waiting for acknowledgments.
Maze Solver Using DSA
Implemented pathfinding algorithms using Data Structures and Algorithms.
Optimized path traversal to efficiently find the shortest or feasible route.
EDUCATION
B.Tech Artificial Intelligence & Data Science 2023 - 2027
Mepco Schlenk Engineering College, Sivakasi
CGPA: 8.14
Higher Secondary Certificate 2022-2023
Cambridge Matric Hr. Sec. School
Percentage: 90.1%
SKILLS
C/C++ Data Structures Web Development
Python Problem-Solving SQL
Java System Design NoSQL
CERTIFICATIONS
NPTEL: Human Computer Interaction IEEE: English for Technical Professionals
NPTEL: Introduction to Industry 4.0 AI Conclave Workshop
NPTEL: Responsible and Safety AI Systems Agentic AI Workshop
ACHIEVEMENTS
Awarded merit-based Management Scholarship for 3 consecutive years for top academic
performance.
